item.title: What Claude Code Actually Is
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: A language model has no filesystem, no shell and no network. Claude Code is the process that supplies them and drives the model in a loop. The execution model, the tools, and the one rule the permission system grows from.
